site_name: Shop, 39 West Green Road, Tottenham, London, N15 5BY
description:
Proposed works consist of the installation of a commercial kitchen extraction and ventilation system including canopy hood, ductwork, carbon
filtration and external fan unit mounted on anti-vibration brackets with high-level discharge to serve a new takeaway food business (Use Class
E / Sui Generis).

The system will include:
APPLICATION –
• Internal canopy hood above cooking equipment
• Galvanised steel ductwork routed internally and exiting at high level on the rear/side elevation
• External extractor fan unit mounted on anti-vibration brackets
• Carbon filtration and grease filtration units to minimise odour emissions
• Vertical discharge terminating above roof height where practicable to ensure safe dispersion

The system will be designed and installed in accordance with DEFRA guidance, DW172 ventilation standards and local authority
environmental health requirements.
